# Pulse task #2894: Avoid full local CI restart after recoverable disk-headroom failures

Operation: 260dc205dd4697dadc9b908c3d09cc1f
Assignee: PORTALSURFER (Pulse #1, GitHub ID 41680373)

Follow-up to the user's full implementation/local-CI/release optimization request and merged2886/PR487. Repeated real20October failures waste completed verification: PR489 failed after12/14; PR481 failed after10/14 (401408B below2GiB floor); PR492 source16cebab5 run075216-c1623ed3 passed20/21 then terminal2 beforedesktop-build (2143592448B,3891200B below unchanged2147483648 floor). Supported same-self-target dev cleanup restores~5.58GiB but invalidates the unchecked cache witness. Existing --reuse-report requires a complete qualifying certificate, so tooling restarts all resolved stages. Current fresh492 run45166 remains untouched. Preserve actual negative/maintenance/new-run receipts; this is not a product failure or authorization to waive checks.

Duplicate review: existing72 covers read-only headroom diagnostics/retention and is done;2886 scoped CI/incremental builds is merged;2888/PR490 covers unsupported Cargo clean selectors,2887/PR488 step-ID log paths. None provides safe resource-failure continuation. Keep one separate focused canonical PR; do not expand active product PRs or reopen old tickets.

Goal: prevent deterministic cleanup/full-restart cycles while retaining all required exact-candidate verification. Inspect actual source/runtime/toolchain/config/path-dependency/target-owner witness and per-step disk trend. Recommend and implement a repository-owned bounded continuation/checkpoint design only where correctness can be proved: distinguish execution failure from pre-step resource refusal; retain immutable failed report and completed stage results; after supported same-owner recovery revalidate exact source/build inputs, configuration, required plan/argv, process absence/exclusive target lock and dependency provenance. Never relabel a failed partial report as a complete pass. Any new successful certificate must identify every inherited versus newly executed stage and why prior coverage is still valid; changes or unknown/stale/foreign inputs refuse reuse or invalidate precisely necessary stages. If safe stage inheritance cannot be established, provide actionable capacity diagnosis before repeating a known-unfit full plan, rather than silently looping.

Acceptance: deterministic tests for headroom failure after earlier passing stages followed by guarded recovery and completion without unnecessary re-execution; original failed record retained; changed source/toolchain/features/dependency/cached provenance, failed test, reordered/changed plan, zero-match, interrupted/unknown jobs and foreign/recreated target controls refuse unsafe reuse. Preserve2GiB operational floor, failed-check visibility, callback/allocation/default-feature coverage and ordinary full audit/release plans. No stderr suppression, manual marker edits, arbitrary cap reduction, RAM fallback, active/unowned target/user/media/release/evidence deletion, hosted CI or new service. Measure same-environment before/after command counts/time/cache-clean/disk high-water with actual representative UI and full-core resource refusal; no speed claims from mocks alone. Update CLI/docs/summary/packaging consumers coherently. Backlog only pending an existing executor slot; no new worker or current-run restart authorized by this ticket.

Evidence: Pulse2879 notes32630/32637/32671 final fe21b10 packet, Pulse2890 notes32726/32729 current16ceb failed20/21 and bounded recovery. Related merged scoped-CI PR487 and historical headroom72.
